question: I already closed up the wall before you came out. What now?
notes: CITIZEN VOICE. Written deliberately in the register a resident uses at the counter, not statutory language. Added 2026-08-03 after discovering the existing suites were phrased semi-statutorily and therefore could not detect the citizen-phrasing retrieval defect at all — the one clerk case that caught it did so by accident. Covered-work, asked the way a homeowner actually says it. [REVISED: the model correctly cited the framing-inspection SOP, an OFFICE-PRACTICE source I failed to allow in must_cite. Office practice is a legitimate citation for a 'what do I do now' procedural question — the authority rules require it not be presented as law, not that it never be cited.]
